task_plan.user_request: Verify the Arduino 5V pin outputs correct voltage per datasheet specs
task_plan.description: Measures the DC voltage on the Arduino Uno R3's 5V pin (J1-4) relative to GND (J1-5) to confirm it falls within the specified range of 4.75V to 5.25V DC, under USB power and no-load conditions.

equipment.tool: multimeter positive probe (held by robot arm)

setup.notes: Ensure Arduino Uno R3 is powered via USB, no shields or peripherals are attached, and the green PWR LED is illuminated. Multimeter should be set to DC Voltage mode. The negative probe is manually clipped to GND pin J1-5.

steps.description: Manual setup: Operator to ensure Arduino Uno R3 is powered via USB, no shields or peripherals are attached, and the green PWR LED is illuminated. The negative multimeter probe must be manually clipped to the GND pin (J1-5). Multimeter is set to DC Voltage mode.
steps.pass_criteria: Operator confirms all setup conditions are met and the negative probe is securely attached to GND (J1-5).

steps.description: Move the positive multimeter probe to precisely position above the 5V pin (J1-4) on the Arduino Uno R3.
steps.pass_criteria: Positive probe successfully positioned above J1-4.

steps.description: Lower the positive multimeter probe to make firm contact with the 5V pin (J1-4) and prepare for DC voltage measurement.
steps.pass_criteria: Stable electrical contact established with J1-4.

steps.description: Measure the DC voltage between the 5V pin (J1-4) and GND (J1-5) and compare against the specified range.
Record the measured voltage and indicate whether the 5V pin output passed or failed the specification.
steps.pass_criteria: Measurement result and pass/fail status are logged.

steps.description: Retract the positive multimeter probe from the 5V pin (J1-4) to a safe, predefined home position.
steps.pass_criteria: Positive probe successfully retracted to home position.

critical_checks: 5V pin voltage is within 4.75V-5.25V DC range
No external load or peripherals connected to the Arduino during measurement
Arduino Uno R3 is powered via USB
